content:
dependabot: Security alert: tokenizers 0.14.1 -> CVE-2026-0812 (wheel path traversal). pip install failing on mac and some manylinux combos. https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-0812
maria: saw this crop up in canary runs this morning, mac-latest and linux-wheel jobs failing intermittently
alex: bisect points to the 0.14.1 wheel metadata change. quick reproducer below:
```
ERROR: Could not build wheels for tokenizers, which is required to install pyproject.toml-based projects
clang: error: linker command failed with exit code 1 (use -v to see invocation)
```
maria: options: pin tokenizers to 0.14.0 and regen poetry.lock, or vendor a patched wheel into our internal artifact repo
jen: if we vendor artifacts there are KMS/RBAC considerations — we sign artifacts with our internal key and policies must log that change
sam: KMS crypto primitives aren't affected by the vuln itself, but any artifact vetting change needs an audit log entry. I'll add an audit item and run a quick KMS policy check
alex: transformers compat looks fine with 0.14.0, but some of our model-serving images were rebuilt with 0.14.1 yesterday. we should avoid a rollout gap
maria: proposal: hotpatch flow
- branch sec/tokenizers-hotfix
- pin tokenizers to 0.14.0 in pyproject.toml and regen poetry.lock
- run full CI matrix (manylinux2014, mac, windows)
- canary deploy to Dedicated beta nodes
jen: also check starlette/fastapi advisories in case there's a related header-level issue; we may need parallel pins
dependabot: opened PR #1347: chore(security): pin tokenizers to 0.14.0 and regenerate lockfile
ci-bot: failing jobs: test-linux-wheel (x2), mac-integration (x1) -- retry suggested
alex: I'll take PR ownership, re-run CI locally inside manylinux2014 container and attach logs here
maria: priority P1 for production-facing rollouts, P2 for dev-only branches. we need a concise SLA for redeploys to enterprise Dedicated customers
sam: audit note: will create an entry "sec/patch/tokenizers-2026-03" with link to PR and CI logs. KMS action: no rotation required but we will record the change and retention policy update
jen: I'll coordinate support/backports for 2.3.x and 2.2.x branches (enterprise customers). Also preparing a short disclosure blurb for legal
alex: timeline: branch + pin in 30m, lock regen + CI in 1h, canary deploy in ~3h if CI green. Will update PR with status
maria: assign backports to jen, owner @alex for primary PR. sam to own audit/compliance card. tagging issue sec/urgent and notify infra for deployment window
jen: ack. will schedule a 15m sync with support and legal after canary green
maria: post-deploy checks: smoke for model-serving endpoints, latency SLOs, and sampling for incorrect responses
alex: attaching local failure logs and docker commands used to repro in the PR description (will paste in a follow-up)
sam: note to infra: please avoid scheduled key rotations during the canary window to reduce noise in audit logs :point_up:
maria: summary: hotfix path agreed. owners set: alex (hotfix PR), jen (backports & customer comms), sam (audit/KMS), maria (triage + release approval). moving to action items. :thumbsup:
